svg.title: Hot spots
svg.desc: Fans buy tickets for one show, and every purchase updates the same inventory row on shard 4. Its load bar climbs to 100 percent while the other shards sit idle. After the row is split into 50 bucket rows across shards, purchases scatter and every shard settles near 32 percent.
svg.text: One hot row pins Shard 4. Split into buckets, the load spreads out.
